index.title: Batch Editing of Office Documents
index.subtitle: Need to create many documents from a template?
index.subtitleLine2: Just pick your template, upload a data table, and generate all the files in one click!

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Generate a large batch of files in seconds.

privacy.title: Full Privacy
privacy.description: Your files never leave your device — everything is processed entirely in your browser.

flexibility.title: Flexibility
flexibility.description: Add as many variables as you need and define a naming pattern for your output files.

step1.title: Prepare your template
step1.description: Mark the data you want to insert automatically. Place variables like {'{'}Name{'}'}, {'{'}Number{'}'}, {'{'}Date{'}'} wherever they should appear in the document.

step2.title: Fill in the table
step2.description: Create an Excel table with the data for your documents and name the column headers exactly like the variables in your template. Note: all fields in the file must be text.

step3.title: Generate the documents
step3.description: Set the naming pattern for your files, click “Generate documents”, and save the Zip folder to your computer.
